newsitem.title: UK: Amstrad says wins 57.5 mln stg in damages.
newsitem.headline: Amstrad says wins 57.5 mln stg in damages.

text.p: British consumer electronics firm Amstrad Plc said on Friday it had been awarded damages of 57.5 million pounds ($93.4 million) in its High Court action against Seagate Technology Inc over faulty computer disk drives.
The damages exclude interest and costs. Amstrad said in a statement it would be applying for interest -- which could be substantial as the claim dates back to 1989 -- on the amount awarded.
Amstrad took up the action in 1992 and the trial took place last year. It is not known if Seagate is considering an appeal.
Amstrad is also taking action against Western Digital Corp , again for faulty computer disk drives, with a trial set for later this year in California. ($ = 0.615 British Pounds)
